newsitem.title: USA: Horizon/CMS home under investigation in Mich.
newsitem.headline: Horizon/CMS home under investigation in Mich.

text.p: Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp said Tuesday that the Michigan attorney general is investigating one of its nursing homes.
The company said the investigation appears to involve allegations that arose out of a previously disclosed licensing review conducted in April.
Horizon/CMS said it believes those unspecified allegations are untrue, and denied the similar allegations apparently involved in the attorney general's investigation.
